item.description:
Release v5.16.0

Changes since v5.15.0

  • docs: add editor rearchitecture plan, refresh architecture notes
  • docs: rewrite README with updated features, architecture, and plugin system
  • docs(ui-performance): record P1/P8 verification and 88-message scroll jank findings
  • feat: add guided empty state for projects list and finalize migration policy
  • feat: add ProviderContentView so plugins can set the main content
  • feat: add ProviderSettingView and assemble settings view into factory
  • feat: add ProviderStorage and assemble it into FactoryLumi2
  • feat: add requiresProject flag to prompt suggestions
  • feat: add SettingGeneralPlugin that registers a General settings entry
  • feat: add toolbar settings button that opens the settings window
  • feat: assemble ActivityBarProviding and wire it into RootView
  • feat: assemble RailViewProviding and wire it into RootView
  • feat: assemble RootViewProviding and replace ProviderWindow with RootView
  • feat: wire ContentViewProviding into the root view
  • feat(app-icon-designer): add plugin manual view with localized guide
  • feat(app-store-promo): add plugin manual view with localized guide
  • feat(AppIconDesignerPlugin): revamp manual view into chaptered guide
  • feat(AppStorePromoDesignerPlugin): rebuild about view with LumiUI landing components
  • feat(AppUpdatePlugin): rebuild about view with LumiUI landing components
  • feat(BookletMakerPlugin): rebuild about view with LumiUI landing components
  • feat: add elegant macOS-style Loading page
  • feat: refactor LLM provider base classes and fix Keychain service regression
  • feat(core): extract KitKeychain as independent package
  • feat(editor-chat): add EditorChatPlugin for sending code references to chat
  • feat(goal-task): add chat toolbar button to display goals
  • feat(goal-task): enforce single active goal policy
  • feat(menu-bar): sort menu bar popup items by order
  • feat(plugin): allow agentTools to throw and surface failures to UI
  • fix(menu-bar): honor LumiMenuBarPopupItem.order when aggregating popup items
  • refactor: move plugin-related types to Plugin directory
  • refactor(agent-tool): extract tool service methods into AgentToolComponent
  • refactor(app): simplify RootContainer and rename project types
  • refactor(bootstrap): merge LumiCoreService into RootContainer
  • refactor(core): introduce ProjectComponent to encapsulate ProjectState
  • refactor(core): remove KitKeychain dependency from LumiLLMProvider protocol
  • refactor(core): remove LumiCoreKit Security module, use KitKeychain directly
  • refactor(goal-task): simplify sidebar to show single active goal
  • refactor(layout): introduce LayoutComponent to encapsulate LumiLayoutState
  • refactor(logo): rename LogoRegistry to LogoComponent, migrate to component pattern
  • refactor(plugins): surface agentTools dependency failures instead of silent returns
